newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - China Eastern rated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - China Eastern rated.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has initiated coverage of China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd with a intermediate-term neutral rating and a long-term buy recommendation.
"With an estimated CAGR (cumulative average growth rate) of 15 percent for the next five year, its growth prospects appear superior to that of its peers," analyst Wendy Wong said in a report.
Given this growth potential, China Eastern shares should trade at a premium to the Southeast Asian airlines average price earnings multiple of 11 times, the report said.
A 30 percent premium would adequately reflect these growth prospects, it added.
Wang estimated the airline's end-1996 gearing at approximately 6.9 times.
"Due to the heavy capital expenditure programme over the next three years, we anticipate China Eastern to suffer a net cash outflow in each of the next two to three years," the report said.
